errors.text: The proposed optimum is 950 °C, whereas the target mechanism and best measured properties occur after SPS at 1000 °C.
The central barrier phase is misidentified as an (Al,Ti)-rich BCC intermetallic network; the target reports oxide barrier phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The falsification experiment uses oxidation at 600 °C rather than the target 900 °C and does not explicitly test the biphasic parabolic rate law against a surface-reaction-limited kinetic model.
The corrosion/passivation mechanism in 3.5 wt% NaCl, including chloride penetration and polarization resistance, is largely omitted.
